buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (1) Price and Scope of Work: The bidder must quote an all-inclusive rate per single-sided A4 page for printing all requested documents (Voter List, Alphabetical Voter List, BLO Register, Information Voter Slips, and Voter Slips) The quoted rate must cover all expenses, including printing, set preparation, cover page printing, installation, glue, stapling, binding, delivery t o our office, all other incidental/Relevant expenses, local taxes, and GST, with no extra char ges allowed. The bidder is fully responsible for understanding all terms without any liability on our office. -The bidder must upload a declaration on their official letterhead, clearly stating that the qu oted price per single page includes printing, stapling, gluing, binding, labour charges for del ivery to this office, transportation, all other incidental/relevant expenses, all taxes, and GST , and that they have quoted their price with this complete understanding. (2) Estimated Quantity and Work Variation: The estimated number of pages mentioned in the bid document are approximate. The actual work volume may vary at the time of executi on. No representations or objections from the bidder regarding this will be accepted. Work will be assigned based on actual requirements, and the final quantity may differ from the c urrent bid estimates. (3) Registered Office Location: The registered office address of the bidder must be located within Kutch District. The bidder must compulsorily submit GST registration Certificate as a documentary evidence for geographical location. (4) Non-Blacklisting Undertaking: The bidder must upload an affidavit confirming that the fi rm/party has not been blacklisted by any other government department, office, or organiza tion. (5) Financial Turnover Criteria: The bidder must have an average annual financial turnover of at least ₹24 Lakhs over the last three financial years CA Cerificate to be uploaded as doc umentary evidence for turn over criteria. (6) Work Experience: The bidder must submit workorders demonstrating a minimum of 3(Thr ee) years of experience in executing similar nature of work. (7) Contract Period and Performance: Upon satisfactory performance of the successful bidd er, the contract duration may be extended for an additional period of 1 (one) year after com pletion of the initial contract term. If the service is found unsatisfactory during the contract period, the contract may be terminated at any time without prior notice. (8) Data Confidentiality and Security: The bidder shall strictly ensure the confidentiality an d security of all data related to the printing work under this contract. The relevant material/ data shall not be sold, shared, or used for any other purpose other than supplying it to this office.

(9) Political Non-Affiliation: The bidder participating in this tender must not be associated w ith or be a member/office bearer of any political party/organization. An affidavit to this effe ct must be submitted by the bidder. (10) Acceptance of Terms: Before starting the work, the successful bidder must a declaration the letter head of the firm. (11) Option Clause (Quantity Variation): The buyer reserves the right to increase or decreas e the contract quantity by up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract or during the currency of the contract. (13) Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): Bidders can submit the EMD via an Account Payee Dema nd Draft (DD) drawn in favor of [Deputy District Election Officer,Kachchh], payable at [O ffice of the District Election officer & Collector Kachchh, Bhuj]. The bidder must ensure that the original Demand Draft (DD) in hard copy reaches this office on or before the last da te of bid submission. (14) Form of EPBG: The successful bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of a Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) in addition to Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG). The FDR sh ould be pledged in the name of [Deputy District Election Officer,Kachchh] or marked as A/C (Name of the Seller). The issuing bank must certify that the deposit can only be withd rawn upon demand or with the explicit sanction of the pledgee. For the release of the depos it, the Buyer will endorse, sign, and stamp the back of the FDR along with a covering letter. The bidder must upload a scanned copy of the FDR in place of the PBG and deliver the origi nal FDR hardcopy to the Buyer within 15 days of the award of the contract. .
